digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler inbound link removal path
propositions: A managed link created locally but never pushed to peer can be incorrectly removed by an inbound removal record if the link's vendor type collides with an existing remote link in the opposite direction

The reconciler's managed_refs monotonicity and G4 outbound-ADD suppression do not protect never-pushed local links when outbound differ dedupes ADDs direction-agnostically on (vendor_type, target_key) rather than relation
Inbound removal records must be declined for managed links that were never peer-confirmed, and declined removals must be logged and surfaced in the per-pass summary
A removal record for a peer-confirmed link must still converge with relation-scoped precision as established by ticket e39f

Peer confirmation is recorded durably per managed link (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) with Jira linkId, confirming snapshot/pass_id, and confirmed_at timestamp, persisted in a .bridge_state sidecar
Confirmation is written on successful outbound link ADD dispatch and populated from authoritative fetched snapshots; partial/paginated/failed reads must never become deletion evidence
